notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000063908-25-000012) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001558370-25-004544), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Ray Kroc is deceased; the proxy calls him 'Our founder', so relation is 'founder' (data.js shows the role 'Former CEO'). His name appears only in that sentence: the proxy discloses no Kroc estate, family, foundation or trust holding, so family is null. HOLDERS: the proxy heads its table 'beneficial owners of more than 5% of our common stock outstanding as of December 31, 2024', but both footnotes say the share counts are as of December 31, 2023, from Schedule 13G/A filings; the holder asOf dates use December 31, 2023. GEOGRAPHY: McDonald's reports revenue by its three segments; International Operated Markets covers markets such as Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain and the U.K., and the third segment combines developmental-licensee markets (including China and Japan) with corporate activities. Intercompany revenues are eliminated.
